product_summary: Radiant Chemicals, Plot A-4 MIDC Kulgaon, Badlapur (E), Dist. Thane, Maharashtra 421503 (second address on site: Plot 110, Chickloli MIDC, Ambernath West 421501). Real product lines per own website (radiantchemicals.com, pages /additives/, /pigment-paste/, /industrial-colorants/, /construction-chemicals/): (1) RHINAPASTE — high-strength aqueous pigment dispersions, organic and inorganic, for in-plant tinting of water-based paints; (2) INDUSTINT — machine-dispensable solvent-borne industrial colorants for acrylics, PU, alkyds, epoxies, NC, melamine, chlorinated rubber; (3) universal stainer, machine colorants, wood stainer; (4) a large ADDITIVES range — anti-settling/anti-sagging (Rhinaset 117), wetting & dispersing agents (Rhinol 40/5310/5320/9000/RC 5207/RC 5044, Rhinaspers 102–192, Rhinaterra-U, Ruosperse CD 1/RA 196), emulsifiers (Ruosperse RN 265, Rhinogen RCN 119), silicone surface additives (Rhinol 300/310/333/337/346/348), acrylate levelling (Rhinol 358), AquaMix, thickeners/rheology modifiers; (5) CONSTRUCTION CHEMICALS — Crack Sealer, Prime Mast, Heat Guard, Rhina Coat, Roof Coat, SBR Bond Coat, Chem Coat 2K (acrylic-emulsion and cementitious waterproofing/coatings). So the company is a formulator of pigment preparations, paint additives and construction/waterproofing coatings — not a primary-form polymer producer.

comment: HS mapping vs declaration: PARTIAL. 320417 is the best-fitting declared code and is genuinely supported — Rhinapaste aqueous pigment dispersions and Industint colorants are synthetic organic colouring matter preparations (3204.17 covers pigment/dye preparations; if sold as dispersions in non-aqueous medium 3212.90 could also apply). 320619 (preparations based on TiO2) is only partially defensible: TiO2 appears on the site solely as a substrate their Ruosperse CD 1 dispersant is designed for, not as a TiO2-pigment product — treat as 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 390690 (acrylic polymers, primary forms) looks WRONG: acrylic emulsion polymer is described as a binder/ingredient inside Rhina Coat, Roof Coat, Heat Guard and Chem Coat 2K, i.e. an input, not an output; no evidence of selling acrylic polymer in primary form. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company is kept, code corrected to the actual product mix. Missing from the declaration (industry misclassification): the whole additives line (wetting/dispersing/emulsifying/silicone surface agents → 3402.90 / 3402.13 / 3910.00), the construction-chemicals line (paints and waterproofing coatings → 3210.00; cement/mortar additives → 3824.40), and thickeners/rheology modifiers. Declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is a paints/coatings/pigment-preparation and construction-chemicals formulator with no oil & gas product line visible on the site. All product identifications above come from the company's own website pages only — no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task, so every code is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the product existence itself is documented on radiantchemicals.com. Note also that the site's /products/ page is an empty stub and /paints/ returns 404, so the paints line is inferred from the navigation menu and the construction-chemicals page rather than a dedicated paints catalogue. No revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN or registry data researched per task scope — null.
